title: The Double Extraction
premise: Tamsin Villalobos, a crash investigator haunted by the unexplained loss of her family in row twelve, is approached by a stranger named Callum who claims she once saved his life—a favor she has no memory of. He demands repayment: help him extract Dr. Ilse Brandt, a defector carrying evidence that the airline Tamsin works for deliberately falsified the maintenance records behind her family's crash. As Tamsin uncovers the conspiracy, she realizes Ilse may be bait in a trap set by the airline's security chief, and the extraction flight at dawn becomes the stage for betrayal, sacrifice, and truth. In the end, Tamsin chooses justice over the law, exposing the records at terrible personal cost, and finally sleeps through the night.
about_author: Oscar Yarrow is the pen name of a former aviation safety analyst who spent a decade reviewing accident reports before turning to fiction. They write thrillers about ordinary professionals pushed past the edge of procedure.

chapters.title: Row Twelve
chapters.summary: Tamsin's POV. She inspects another wreck site, unable to sleep since losing her family on Flight 4471. Flashbacks of row twelve intrude during the investigation. Emotional beat: grief calcified into routine.

chapters.title: The Stranger with the Debt
chapters.summary: Callum appears at Tamsin's apartment claiming she saved his life years ago—she remembers nothing. He leaves a burner phone and a name: Ilse Brandt. Emotional beat: unease and curiosity.

chapters.title: Interest Owed
chapters.summary: Tamsin runs background checks on Callum and finds nothing; someone has scrubbed him from every database. Her insomnia deepens. Emotional beat: paranoia taking root.

chapters.title: The Favor That Never Happened
chapters.summary: Callum's POV. We learn he fabricated—or half-remembers—the debt as leverage, but his motive is tangled with guilt. Emotional beat: moral ambiguity.

chapters.title: Maintenance Log 4471
chapters.summary: Tamsin pulls the official file on her family's flight and notices an impossible gap in the hydraulic inspection records. Emotional beat: first crack of suspicion.

chapters.title: Ilse Brandt, Defector
chapters.summary: Callum explains: Brandt was the quality auditor who signed off on falsified inspections and is now fleeing with proof. The extraction flight leaves at dawn in nine days. Emotional beat: stakes crystallize.

chapters.title: Why Me
chapters.summary: Tamsin confronts Callum about why she's needed; he admits her credentials grant access to the hangar where Brandt is hiding. Emotional beat: reluctant complicity.

chapters.title: The Hangar at Meridian Field
chapters.summary: Tamsin scouts the airfield under pretext of a routine audit, mapping cameras and guards. She spots a woman watching from a maintenance loft. Emotional beat: adrenaline and dread.

chapters.title: Watching the Watchers
chapters.summary: Brandt's POV. She distrusts everyone, including her rescuers, and hides a second copy of the evidence. Emotional beat: isolation.

chapters.title: Security Chief Dane Rourke
chapters.summary: Rourke's POV. He suspects an insider leak and begins quietly pulling personnel files—including Tamsin's. Emotional beat: cold menace.

chapters.title: A Night Without Sleep
chapters.summary: Tamsin relives the crash notification call; Callum unexpectedly shares his own loss, building fragile trust between them. Emotional beat: intimacy against instinct.

chapters.title: The Second Copy
chapters.summary: Tamsin discovers Brandt has duplicated the records onto a data chip sewn into a flight jacket—an old investigator's trick Tamsin herself invented. Emotional beat: recognition.

chapters.title: Rourke Closes In
chapters.summary: Rourke flags Tamsin's hangar access and sets surveillance. A near-miss in the parking lot raises the temperature. Emotional beat: hunted.

chapters.title: Terms of Extraction
chapters.summary: Callum lays out the plan: move Brandt to a charter at dawn, day eight. Tamsin insists on verifying the evidence first. Emotional beat: control versus chaos.

chapters.title: Reading the Dead Man's Signature
chapters.summary: Tamsin authenticates the falsified signatures—one belongs to an inspector who died suspiciously after Flight 4471. Emotional beat: rage igniting.

chapters.title: The Bait Question
chapters.summary: Tamsin voices what neither wants said: Brandt may be bait to draw out whoever leaked the records. Callum doesn't deny it. Emotional beat: trust fracturing.

chapters.title: Dane's Offer
chapters.summary: Rourke approaches Tamsin directly, offering immunity and closure on row twelve if she hands over Brandt. Emotional beat: temptation.

chapters.title: Love Against Duty
chapters.summary: Tamsin and Callum, running out of safe houses, admit feelings neither can afford. Emotional beat: tenderness under threat.

chapters.title: The Dead Inspector's Widow
chapters.summary: Tamsin tracks down the widow, who confirms her husband found the falsifications and was silenced. Emotional beat: grief finding purpose.

chapters.title: Compromised Channel
chapters.summary: Callum discovers their comms were intercepted days ago; the dawn plan is known. Someone inside the team is leaking. Emotional beat: betrayal looming.

chapters.title: The Mole
chapters.summary: Tamsin identifies the leak: the charter pilot, bought by Rourke. They must swap aircraft overnight. Emotional beat: grim resolve.

chapters.title: Six Hours to Dawn
chapters.summary: Frantic logistics: new plane, forged manifest, moving Brandt through cargo tunnels. Emotional beat: ticking-clock tension.

chapters.title: Ambush at Gate Nine
chapters.summary: Rourke's men hit the tunnel early; Callum is wounded covering Brandt's escape. Emotional beat: sacrifice.

chapters.title: Blood on the Tarmac
chapters.summary: Tamsin triages Callum while Brandt freezes; the extraction window shrinks to minutes. Emotional beat: desperation.

chapters.title: Rourke's Truth
chapters.summary: Cornered, Rourke reveals he didn't order the falsification—he's cleaning up for someone above him, and offers Tamsin that name. Emotional beat: shifting loyalties.

chapters.title: The Name Above
chapters.summary: The trail leads to the airline's chairman, who signed off on deferring maintenance to save the quarter that killed row twelve. Emotional beat: fury with focus.

chapters.title: Flight Plan Change
chapters.summary: They reroute the extraction through a regional strip, buying hours but burning allies. Emotional beat: cost accounting.

chapters.title: What Brandt Carries
chapters.summary: Brandt confesses she signed the false records under duress; her evidence indicts herself too. Emotional beat: shame and courage.

chapters.title: Dawn Approaches
chapters.summary: Final preparations; Tamsin uploads a dead-man's-switch copy of the evidence to regulators and press. Emotional beat: quiet determination.

chapters.title: The Chairman's Plane
chapters.summary: The chairman arrives personally to stop them, bringing federal agents fed a counter-narrative. Emotional beat: power's impunity.

chapters.title: Standoff on Runway Two
chapters.summary: Armed standoff at sunrise; Tamsin broadcasts the evidence live, forcing the agents to choose sides. Emotional beat: courage tipping the scale.

chapters.title: Betrayal's Price
chapters.summary: The bought pilot, conscience-stricken, testifies on the tarmac; Rourke turns state's evidence against the chairman. Emotional beat: redemption, costly.

chapters.title: Extraction
chapters.summary: Brandt's plane lifts off as the chairman is detained; Callum, bleeding, watches from the ambulance. Emotional beat: release.

chapters.title: Aftermath of the Fall
chapters.summary: Investigations open; Tamsin loses her job for the unauthorized audit but gains the truth. Emotional beat: bittersweet reckoning.

chapters.title: Justice Outside the Law
chapters.summary: Hearings begin; Tamsin testifies not as an employee but as a daughter of row twelve. Emotional beat: voice reclaimed.

chapters.title: What Callum Owes
chapters.summary: Callum's true history surfaces—he was the junior mechanic who missed the flaw and let the debt story bind him to making amends. Emotional beat: forgiveness considered.

chapters.title: The Verdict
chapters.summary: The chairman is indicted; maintenance reform legislation bears the victims' names. Emotional beat: justice, imperfect but real.

chapters.title: Returning the Favor
chapters.summary: Tamsin helps Callum face his own reckoning, dissolving the debt between them into something freely given. Emotional beat: love without ledger.

chapters.title: First Night
chapters.summary: Months later, Tamsin visits the memorial wall, says goodbye to row twelve, and goes home. Emotional beat: mourning completed.

chapters.title: Sleeping Through
chapters.summary: Epilogue, Tamsin's POV. She wakes at dawn naturally, rested, a new case file waiting—but this time she opens it standing in daylight. Emotional beat: peace earned.
